settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 ship at a flat $4.95. Express delivery is available at checkout.

settings.question: How long will delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Mon–Fri). Standard delivery then takes 3–6 business days, and express 1–3 business days.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. International delivery typically takes 7–14 business days. Any customs duties or import taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You'll receive a tracking link by email the moment your order ships. Please allow up to 48 hours for tracking to begin updating.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day glow guarantee. If you're not completely in love, return your items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — even if they're opened.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Email us at hello@luma.com with your order number and the items you'd like to return. We'll send a prepaid return label and simple instructions.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged or incorrect — what now?
settings.answer: Email hello@luma.com within 7 days with a photo and your order number. We'll make it right with a replacement or full refund — no return shipping needed.
